metadata.description: Existing Linux runner VM in the selected resource group, with private access to the Dev project. No VM is created.
Azure region of the existing runner VM. Change this if the VM is in a different region from its resource group.
Absolute path to the prepared consumer repository on that VM. Its accelerator submodule and project configuration are reused, not overwritten.
Absolute path to the existing Python 3.12+ environment on the VM with the Agent Factory operator dependencies installed.
Client ID of the existing user-assigned managed identity attached to the VM and authorized to deploy Agent Chat. No identity or role assignment is created by this entry point.
Subscription containing the Dev project; must match its variables.json. The selected resource group above contains the runner VM.
Existing Dev project number, 001-999. This deploys the Foundry agent, knowledge index and private chat app with live voice, not Factory infrastructure or model deployments.
Optional path to the project variables.json, relative to consumerRoot or absolute on the VM. Leave empty to resolve the unique matching project.
Change this value to rerun a completed deployment. Do not run this entry and a project pipeline concurrently.

results.value: Read this Run Command instance view for the application URL or failure details. The chat URL requires private network access and the configured Entra sign-in.
